parsedVerdict.reasoning: This file is a composition root. initializeDependencies() creates the domain objects (Catalog, OrderRepository), connects them to the application use cases, and returns them in a Dependencies container. Server and routes code in infrastructure uses that container. Wiring objects together and bootstrapping the app at startup are framework and configuration work, which belongs in the infrastructure layer. The file loads sample products with catalog.addProduct calls. That is startup seed data passed through an existing domain API. It does not define pricing, validation, stock rules or order state transitions, so it is not a business rule placed in infrastructure. The file holds no domain logic, does no persistence work of its own and has no transport handling. Every responsibility fits the infrastructure layer.
